guarantees.claim: On posedge clk_i, if !rst_ni, cyc_ctr_q is assigned 3'd0.
On posedge clk_i, if rst_ni holds, cyc_ctr_q is updated with the value of cyc_ctr_d.

assumptions.claim: cyc_ctr_d must be stable and valid at the rising edge of clk_i when rst_ni is high; it is expected to carry the next counter value.
assumptions.risk: If cyc_ctr_d is glitchy or invalid (e.g., X, out-of-range), cyc_ctr_q may latch an illegal value, corrupting AES round control.

uncertain_points.claim: The logic generating cyc_ctr_d (e.g., increment, round limit) is defined elsewhere; if it allows cyc_ctr_q to exceed legal AES round count without wrap-around, the FSM may enter illegal states.
uncertain_points.cond: Whenever cyc_ctr_d drives a value beyond the intended round range.
uncertain_points.risk: AES control may issue extra rounds or read invalid round keys, leading to incorrect cipher or fault.
